text: The Dewey project. This is our design for the Dwey character. The embodiment of our aetic educational AI framework. Inspired by progressive educational philosopher John Dwey. The Dooey framework is our open-source platform for educational intelligence that orchestrates specialized AI agents to transform how we learn and teach. Just as John Dwey revolutionized education with his experiential learning philosophy, our Dwey framework coordinates intelligent agents that work in concert to create personalized interactic educational experiences.
